mapper.insert: insert into sys_role( role_id, role_name, create_time, creator_id, sys_state )values( #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{roleName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{creatorId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{sysState, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.delete: delete from sys_role where role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.update:
update sys_role a a.role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, a.role_name = #{roleName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.create_time = #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, a.creator_id = #{creatorId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, a.sys_state = #{sysState, jdbcType=INTEGER},
where a.role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: select a.role_id, a.role_name, a.create_time, a.creator_id, a.sys_state from sys_role a where 1 = 1 and a.role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1
SELECT b.menu_code AS Id FROM sys_role a LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu b ON a.role_id = b.role_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT a.role_id, a.role_name, b.region_id, c.region_name FROM sys_role a LEFT JOIN sys_role_region b ON a.role_id = b.role_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region c ON b.region_id = c.region_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT a.role_id, a.role_name, b.camera_id, c.camera_name, c.camera_type, c.url, c.port FROM sys_role a LEFT JOIN sys_role_camera b ON a.role_id = b.role_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_info c ON b.camera_id = c.camera_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT a.role_id, a.role_name, b.device_id, c.device_name, c.custom_id, c.custom_name FROM sys_role a LEFT JOIN sys_role_device b ON a.role_id = b.role_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device c ON b.device_id = c.device_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT c.region_id AS Id,d.region_name AS label,d.up_region_id AS upId,"region" AS infoType FROM sys_role b LEFT JOIN sys_role_region c ON b.role_id = c.role_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON c.region_id = d.region_id WHERE b.role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND c.is_checked = "checked" UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT c.device_id AS Id,d.device_name AS label,d.up_region_id AS upId,"device" AS infoType FROM sys_role b LEFT JOIN sys_role_device c ON b.role_id = c.role_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device d ON c.device_id = d.device_id WHERE b.role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND c.is_checked = "checked") UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT c.camera_id AS Id,d.camera_name AS label,d.up_region_id AS upId,"camera" AS infoType FROM sys_role b LEFT JOIN sys_role_camera c ON b.role_id = c.role_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_info d ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE b.role_id = #{roleId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND c.is_checked = "checked")
